name: missed-call-offer
title: Missed Call Offer
one_liner: When a prospect's phone goes unanswered, offer them the thing that would have answered it.
description: A stub, included to show that ProofRun is a skill on a platform rather than the whole product. The agent core discovers this folder from the filesystem the same way it discovers proofrun; it has a manifest and a prompt but no runner, so the core reports it as a stub and refuses to invoke it. See prompt.md for the intended loop.

call_window.description: When to place the test call.

guarantees: No call is ever placed. The telephony adapter does not exist.
blocked_on: A telephony provider and the consent and recording law that comes with placing test calls to businesses. That is a legal question before it is an engineering one, which is exactly why this skill is a stub.
